description: The Science Data Bank deposit maps land use and land cover in the lower Yellow River floodplain at 30-metre resolution for eight five-year points between 1985 and 2020. The Henan University and Chinese Academy of Sciences team used Landsat 5 and GF-1 imagery with random-forest classification and visual interpretation. The repository reports overall accuracy above 90 percent and Kappa above 0.85, and lists CC BY 4.0 with public access. Flood-risk or river-corridor modellers could use these maps to reconstruct changing exposure, roughness assumptions or land-use conditions near levees and settlements. The product is a sequence of classified snapshots, not an annual flood record or direct measurement of defence condition. Aggregate accuracy does not reveal the error rate for every rare class or date. Files, class legend and local accuracy tables were not downloaded or checked. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified.
name: A 30m land use/cover change dataset from 1985 to 2020 in the floodplain of the lower Yellow River
